feature-dev.note: Spots the real build break (duplicate FormatComments at table.go:238), debug-to-stdout corrupting JSON, and the duplicated custom-ID query, and lays out compared architecture options with decisions and risks.

code-design.note: Precisely identifies the build break and which duplicate to delete, with full signatures, data table and numbered call chains including error paths, but offers no JSON output and leaves debug-on-stdout alone.

plain.note: Sound layering and a verified cobra routing check, but asserts make check passes when the repo does not compile and gives only bullet-level unit descriptions with no signatures or call chain.

superpowers.note: Good design touches (debug to stderr, statusUpdater interface, JSON mode) but misses that main does not build and claims make check passes, and is thin on call-level detail.

reason: W and X were the only plans that discovered the repository does not compile (duplicate DetailFormatter.FormatComments), a fact that changes the first step of any implementation, and they presented concrete decisions that can be challenged individually. W edges X by weighing alternative architectures and covering JSON output, stdout/stderr hygiene and risks, while Z and Y both state that make check passes, which is false, and give less reviewable detail.
